_README: Single source of truth for everything the agents may say about FormatForge. Workers may only state product facts found here. Reviewers check drafts against it. Edit it, then set owner_confirmed to true. Nothing publishes until you do.
one_line: FormatForge turns rough text into a cleanly formatted Microsoft Word (.docx) document, with three tools: Academic Paper Forge, AI Cleaner & Auditor, and ATS Resume Forge.

academic.name: Academic Paper Forge
does: Fixes in-text citations and reference entries in APA 7, MLA 9, Harvard, Chicago 17 or IEEE style (the free preview runs in APA 7 only)
Flags in-text citations that are missing from the reference list, and the reverse
Exports a .docx with 1 inch margins, double line spacing (1.15 for IEEE) and 0.5 inch hanging indents on the reference list
Can add an optional cover page from the details you enter

cleaner.name: AI Cleaner & Auditor
does: Strips leftover Markdown such as ### headings and ** bold markers from pasted AI-generated text
Replaces stock transition phrases that AI tools tend to overuse
Flags factual claims, statistics and numbers in the text that have no citation

resume.name: ATS Resume Forge
does: Turns rough experience notes into a resume laid out for one page: single column, 0.6 inch margins, uppercase section headers
Rewrites bullets using the XYZ formula, using only numbers that appear in your notes, and flags bullets that still need a real number from you
Accepts an optional target job title or keywords, and suggests three keywords in the audit

pricing: One free preview run per tool, up to 6,000 characters, showing the opening of the result and the first audit item. A one-time $1.99 Single-Tool Pass unlocks the full result, the full audit, re-runs and the .docx download for that one tool, up to 35,000 characters per document, subject to fair use. Never describe the pass as unlimited.
privacy_statement: FormatForge does not store your documents: your text is processed in memory to produce your result and is not saved by FormatForge. Processing uses OpenAI's API, so your text is sent to OpenAI for that purpose.
required_disclosure: FormatForge is AI-assisted. Always review the result before you submit or send it.
does_not: Does not guarantee any grade, job interview, or applicant tracking system outcome
Does not verify that a cited source exists or is accurate; it only flags and reformats what is in your text
Does not make any text undetectable by AI detectors and does not promise any result in plagiarism or AI-detection tools
Is not a substitute for reading the official style guide or your instructor's or employer's requirements
Is not a subscription: the pass is a one-time payment
Does not guarantee that a resume fits on one page
Does not check text against plagiarism or AI-detection tools
style_fact_policy: General facts about style guides (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE) may be stated only when the writer is certain they are correct. Otherwise tell the reader to check the official guide.
pass_note: There are no accounts. A purchased pass is kept as a link in the browser's address bar, so the buyer should bookmark the page.
